scripts.build: bun build frontend/app.js --outdir public/assets --minify && bun build frontend/style.css --outdir public/assets --minify && cp node_modules/html5-qrcode/LICENSE public/assets/html5-qrcode.LICENSE.txt
scripts.dev: bun run build && php -S 127.0.0.1:8080 -t public router.php
scripts.test: php tests/domain.php && php tests/barcodes.php && bun test tests
